info.name: CollabCraft
info.summary: Shared editing for the Craft apps
info.description:
Lets the Craft apps (PhotoCraft, GridCraft, WordCraft and the rest) edit a Nextcloud file together.
This app is the control plane. It authenticates the user, checks whether they may edit the file, and mints a short-lived signed token. A separate relay process holds the sockets and orders the edits, because PHP cannot hold a persistent connection. That is the same split Nextcloud uses for Client Push, Talk and Office.
info.author: William Dunn
